text: We interrupt this program to bring you a special bulletin. Nonimaginaires, the brain fogs, are eating the California Trail. Five pages are going gray. Behind the fog is a dead air that swallows stories.
A silent keeper steps through the glass. Color is already leaving the wagon road. Jang and Tom are selling a story the fog has started to eat.
A torn page. Two debtors printed flashy handbills and hired themselves out as guides who had never guided a wagon.
A torn page. Pawnee warriors had the train surrounded. Jang bought the peace with dentistry.
A torn page. The bear hunt turned inside out. The hunters became the hunted.
A torn page. Bandits held the narrows until Tom, the clumsiest human pendulum in the West, cleared them on the backswing.
A torn page. The river would not ford, so the crossing became a floating circus of wagons.
Bulletin from the canyon. Bandits wrapped in fog. A swinging rope is about to finish the argument.
We take you to the river. The crossing is scrambled. Those wagons have to float before this picture can go on.
Stand by for the ford. The bear from the hunt has fused with a Nonimaginaire. It is trying to erase the pages.
The pages are back in the book. Color returns to the signal. We return you now to your regular program.
